# Third-Party Dependencies

This directory contains external dependencies used by LIVerse.

## LIV (Language-Image-Value)

- **Source**: https://github.com/penn-pal-lab/LIV
- **License**: MIT
- **Description**: Vision-language model that encodes images and text into a shared embedding space using CLIP/ResNet50 backbone. Used for computing VLM-based reward signals.

## Metaworld

- **Source**: https://github.com/Farama-Foundation/Metaworld
- **License**: MIT
- **Description**: Multi-task robotic manipulation benchmark. Provides ML1/ML10/ML45 task suites for meta-learning evaluation.
